description.value: Lamb Hot Pot is a casual Chinese hotpot restaurant in a Richmond strip mall specializing in lamb-based pots served with bones, marrow, and cumin lamb skewers. The restaurant features a DIY dipping sauce cart and offers plastic gloves for hands-on eating — a fun, communal experience well suited to groups. Reviewers highlight generous portions and a welcoming atmosphere despite the no-frills setting.
